title: Studio a11y: several inputs have no accessible name — form designer group title, field inspector Description and Help text, Interfaces nav inspector "Link to object" combobox and "Label"
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

Screen-reader users hear unnamed edit fields; automated a11y checks fail on these controls.

## Reproduction

1. Data › Form designer › a group title input → no `aria-label` / `<label for>` (ObjectFormDesigner.tsx ~483).
2. Field inspector › Description / Help text (ObjectFieldInspector.tsx ~1050 / ~1067) → unnamed.
3. Interfaces › a nav item inspector › "Link to object" combobox and "Label" input → visual labels not associated.

## Expected

Each input has an associated label or aria-label.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

The files named above under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/`.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Data and Interfaces QA cards (accessibility tree read).
- Business reason: Accessibility of the builder itself; cheap fixes.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Studio inspector inputs without accessible name label a11y` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 3 hits, none about these inputs (closed #7973, #5084, #5417).
- QA id: U7
